milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must be within viewing distance of the kelp_plant and actively facing toward it. Target is the center kelp cluster at spawn-relative (0, 0, 7). max_distance=16 allows observation from shore or while wading. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the kelp, not facing away. This correctly models 'player can see the kelp_plant.'

Uses inventory_has because mining sugar_cane causes it to drop as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. Sugar cane is instant-mine with any tool or bare hands. Three clusters of 3-tall sugar cane are available at the water's edge (z=5). The player starts with no sugar_cane in inventory, so min_count=1 confirms mining occurred.
